summary.text: Cathy Tilton was appointed to the Alaska Senate for District M in 2025 from the Alaska House of Representatives, where she had served since 2015 and resigned on November 29, 2025.

paragraphs.text: In the House she was Minority Leader (2021 to 2022) and the 23rd Speaker of the House (2023 to 2024), according to her legislative biography.
The biography says she grew up in Anchorage, has lived in the Mat-Su area for more than 30 years, and earned a certificate in accounting and travel from Alaska Business College.
